title: Batch Push
description: Send messages to connected bots' users / groups. Supports HTML and base64 images.
sectionTextDesc: HTML body. Images appear as short placeholders in the editor; base64 is expanded only on submit so large images won't freeze the page.
imageHint: Drop / Ctrl+V / button to insert. Editor keeps short placeholders (data-bp-id); preview shows the image; submit expands to base64.
sectionTargetsDesc: Pick bot and target groups/users. Value is g:<id>|<bot_id> or u:<id>|<bot_id>.
targetsPlaceholder: Multi-select; ALL* macros and specific values can coexist
note1: Use ALLUSER / ALLGROUP to target all users / groups.
note2: Targets must be active bots; disconnected bots are silently skipped.
historyEmpty: No recent pushes; they will appear here after a successful push.
defaultBody: ZaoYou Core maintenance: tonight 23:00–23:30 restart, service paused.
